caseName: Southern Bell Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. Federal Communications Commission
caseNameFull: Southern Bell Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. Federal Communications Commission and New England Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. Federal Communications Commission

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of Communications Satellite Corp. for leave to file a reply as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied. Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions.
